title: Quickstart contract tools keep whole-unit slots writable and measurable, and skip demo-only entities in the label rules and the verify viewer
steps: S1: From the checkout run the run.cmd below (the content coverage tests and the Joomla capture tests).
S2: Read the TAP result of each test named in run.tests.
expect:
capture --whole-units keeps

Train hard daily

as an image slot plus three text slots, not one merged text slot.
A block 'Ring Ready' matches the whole-unit slot 'Ring Ready Now' by piece-of-whole-unit; 'Rea' does not match.
R7 does not flag an icon and the words of one item description; it flags the same piece with a different role across items.
A slot inside a composite block gets maxChars equal to the block's capacity minus the other pieces' characters.
Viewer rule 4 does not mark a slot shown only through a link; it marks one shown as text.
An entity marked demoOnly: true has no slot in R1 to R8 and no suspicious flag in the viewer; R9 still counts every hole.
evidence: Capturing and auditing the JA Boxing 1.0.8 contract (#46): words beside an image were dropped, heading pieces were reported as holes, and the Typography style-guide article failed R8 six times.
fence: Pure functions and the capture script over fictional fixtures; no browser and no stand.

tests: a word-bounded piece of a whole-unit slot
R7: the pieces of one HTML field
a block several slots make up together
rule 4 asks for a measurable box
C1: an image beside the words
